This repository contains the implementation of the gemma PyPI package. A JAX library to use and fine-tune Gemma. For examples and use cases, see our documentation. Please report issues and feedback in our GitHub.

sources.snippet: Gemma-2B-it Gemma, a family of lightweight, state-of-the-art open models by Google, inherits the same advanced research and technology as the Gemini models. These text-to-text, decoder-only large language models come in English variants, offering open weights, pre-trained versions, and fine-tuned options.
